tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Sunk ground: footer, the band behind the status bar, inset wells.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page ground. The hi-fi NYKO mark is tuned to sit on the dark value.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels: mission cards, crew file, diagram plates.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill on panels and secondary buttons. Body text only (ink, ink-muted) sits on it; never ink-subtle.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The engineering grid drawn on surface-100. Decorative: never carries meaning, never under text-sized marks alone.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline seams: dividers, panel edges, table rules, back arcs of orbits.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised seams, tick marks and contour index lines. Decorative strength: do not use where a border must be found (use control).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders that must be found: secondary buttons, inputs, toggles. 3:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on every surface. 12:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, metadata on surface-000/100/200/300. 6:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Telemetry labels and units on surface-100 and surface-200 only (4.8:1+). Not on surface-300.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: THE accent (≈ International Orange). Fills: primary button, the leading edge of a trajectory, the active marker, the flame. Under ~10% of any viewport. Text on it is on-ember.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Ember as type or a thin stroke that must read: active nav label, a highlighted readout, link hover. 4.7:1+ on surface-100/200 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ember or amber fill (5.2:1 on ember). Never white on ember.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Secondary warm: the orb, flame mid-tone, hover warmth on ember elements. A fill or mark, not body text in light theme.

tokens.name: flame-core
tokens.usage: Hottest point only: flame cores, mach diamonds, the brightest pixel of a highlight. Never a background.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Hardware accent from the mark: fairing band, solar panels. Small fills only; not text on dark.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Data in diagrams: the plotted line of an elevation profile, a route on a topo map, a selected series. 5.6:1+ on surfaces, so it may also label.

tokens.name: nominal
tokens.usage: Status: nominal / on duty / live. Always paired with the word (NOMINAL) — never colour alone.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Status: caution, LOSS OF SIGNAL, stale data. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring at 2px offset. 7:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: hull-xlight
tokens.usage: Illustration only — lightest hull tone (logo center booster). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: hull-light
tokens.usage: Illustration only — hull highlight, satellite body.

tokens.name: hull-mid
tokens.usage: Illustration only — hull mid-tone, star-chart crosses on the cover and in diagrams.

tokens.name: hull-shadow
tokens.usage: Illustration only — hull shadow, deep plate in diagrams.

tokens.name: deep-indigo
tokens.usage: Illustration only — flat favicon-tier rocket fill.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I build the systems that have to work.
styles.usage: Hero line and the first sentence of a section. ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I chose the harder auth model because background access would matter later.
styles.usage: Running copy. ink on any surface; max 68ch.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Shipped conservative and human-in-the-loop, then tightened.
styles.usage: Card copy, captions. ink or ink-muted.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: A big number in a readout or a stat. ink; ember-text only for the one figure that matters.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values in key/value tables, coordinates, timestamps. ink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, section numbers, nav, buttons. ink-subtle or ink-muted.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Figure captions, axis labels, registration notes. ink-subtle; never below 11px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The base module; minor grid pitch; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (small), gutters inside cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, card gaps, page margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; star-cross pitch.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop; title to content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Major grid pitch; between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: panels, plates, photos, the grid. Hardware is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, inputs — just enough to soften a pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: The largest radius in the system: tooltips and toasts only.

stroke.note: Line weights for diagrams, seams and borders. The system has no shadows: depth comes from overlap and hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Seams, panel edges, grid, back arcs, contour lines.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Index contours, axis lines, tick marks, control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-lead
tokens.usage: The leading edge: the front arc of an orbit, a plotted route, the active trajectory.
